dag_and_objective_assessment.reason: Every selectable window parent has a strictly smaller spatial index in the same timestep; the added selected-parent edge and the canonical up-row edge therefore both point forward in execution order.
dag_and_objective_assessment.qualification: The always-present canonical up-row edge can serialize rows even when up is not selected. This is safe for the negative promotion decision but is not an RTL proof and may pessimistically charge performance.
dag_and_objective_assessment.objective_misalignment: The producer chooses each row parent before grouping, minimizing that row's bank-issue cycles, then population and priority. The scheduler later minimizes OR-union work over the already chosen deltas. Individually favorable but dissimilar deltas can enlarge group union work, and new parent edges alter readiness/fusion overlap.
dag_and_objective_assessment.receipt_wording_correction: Describe the objective as per-destination bank-cycle minimization with population as a tie-break, not simply delta-population minimization.
dag_and_objective_assessment.causal_strength: The regressions demonstrate objective failure for this frozen screen. They do not separately identify union-mask versus dependency/readiness causality because no same-mask DAG ablation was sealed.

go: Exact-SHA identity of the two logs and two full configuration results
Exact log progress population and result-level ten-sample aggregation
Origin/distance populations, frozen K4/K6 comparison arithmetic, and all gate booleans
Window64 as a negative hardware-algorithm feedback screen on the frozen cohort

findings.finding: The contract was written after execution launch, although before the copied result files completed. The raw logs contain no timestamped exact command, contract/probe SHA, Git identity, host, interpreter, or environment attestation.
findings.impact: The gates are useful fail-closed checks, but cannot be represented as strictly preregistered or cryptographically bound to these executions.
findings.required_action: For any successor, freeze the contract first and launch only through an exact-SHA runner that records command, environment, host, start/end time, and output SHA.

findings.finding: Each parent choice scans up to 64 previous rows and evaluates XOR delta, bank-issue cycles, population, and a reduction/tie-break, but matcher query/response latency, comparator/popcount/reduction hardware, address lookup, ports, wire, timing, and power are all uncharged.
findings.impact: Even a positive transaction result would not establish realizable module performance; this negative result gives no basis to promote the matcher.
findings.required_action: Do not promote window64. If revisited, use a bounded candidate table, executable latency/port model, and synthesized matcher before any cycle claim.

findings.finding: Logs prove that 40 named records reached progress markers and results expose ten per-sample ledgers, but no per-record transaction ledger is sealed. The independent audit therefore cannot reconstruct the scheduler decisions or verify each record's contribution.
findings.impact: Arithmetic consistency is strong, event-model correctness remains producer-dependent.
findings.required_action: Seal per-record parent choices, group union masks/cycles, dependency waits, and charged-cycle decomposition for a retained design.

findings.finding: Parent selection minimizes individual row bank cycles before K-way OR-union grouping and before readiness effects are known. K4 saves 1.3942% source cycles but regresses integrated cycles 0.2863%; K6 regresses source 0.1605%, integrated 0.8662%, and p95 0.8136%.
findings.impact: The proposed heuristic does not improve the actual screened hardware objective and can destroy fusion overlap.
findings.required_action: Train/select on group-union bank cycles plus explicit dependency, parent-port, and wait penalties; freeze that objective before rerunning.

findings.finding: M90 has no matcher RTL, VCS differential replay, DC/STA, SRAM macro/ports, PT power, or equal-area/equal-frequency baseline.
findings.impact: No RTL cycle, PPA, energy, throughput-per-area, or system claim is admitted.
findings.required_action: The current NO-GO makes implementation unnecessary; only a future positive, preregistered bounded matcher should enter RTL/PPA.

findings.finding: Evidence remains ten valid825-internal windows and four H67 Conv3x3 operators, without PAFT accuracy, sequence-disjoint data, density strata, all-network operators, or end-to-end memory timing.
findings.impact: No generalization, accuracy-preserving, full-network, or system conclusion follows.
findings.required_action: Evaluate any replacement objective on disjoint sequences and density strata, then compose all charged operators.

findings.finding: Strictly earlier spatial parents make the added dependency acyclic, while the preserved unconditional up-row progress edge can add dependencies unrelated to the selected parent.
findings.impact: This favors a safe negative decision but may pessimistically attribute regression to the window heuristic.
findings.required_action: If causality matters, add a sealed same-mask DAG ablation while preserving correctness.

findings.finding: No ablation holds chosen masks constant while removing only window dependency/readiness changes, so union-mask and DAG/port-wait effects are not individually identified.
findings.impact: The NO-GO is firm, but 'destroys fused union overlap' is a mechanism inference rather than isolated proof.
findings.required_action: Use a two-factor mask-objective versus DAG-cost ablation only if this line is revisited.

findings.finding: The receipt says each destination delta is minimized, while code primarily minimizes bank-issue cycles and uses population only as the second tie-break.
findings.impact: Hardware-to-algorithm feedback could optimize the wrong scalar if copied literally.
findings.required_action: State the exact lexicographic objective and replace it with an explicit fused-group hardware cost.

findings.finding: The contract freezes M69 analyzer/result identities, but the M90 probe neither hashes nor loads them; the operative producer lineage is M45 plus M43.
findings.impact: The input manifest is broader than the executable dependency chain and can mislead provenance review.
findings.required_action: Separate contextual design ancestry from executable inputs in the next contract.

findings.finding: Nearest-rank p95 over ten samples is the maximum observation for both configurations.
findings.impact: The p95 arithmetic is exact but has weak tail characterization.
findings.required_action: Use more sequence-disjoint, density-stratified windows for any retained candidate.
